S01: In ancient Ireland, among the green hills, lived a young piper.
S02: He played with all his heart, but his melodies were rough and tuneless.
S03: He practiced all day long, but the song came out ragged.
S04: Even the birds flew away whenever he began to play.
S05: Piper: "At least I know one song."
S06: Then, out of the forest mist, appeared a shadow with horns.
S07: It was the Pooka, a forest spirit who loved to frighten and jest with people.
S09: Pooka: "Do not be afraid, young man!"
S10: Pooka: "Climb onto my back! Hold onto my horns!"
S11: Pooka: "I will take you to play for me a little."
S12: Piper: "But I know only one song."
S13: Pooka: "It does not matter. I will turn you into the finest piper."
S14: And so the young man climbed onto the spirit's back.
S15: The Pooka raced through the forest like the wind.
S17: They reached the mouth of a cave in the rock.
S19: Inside awaited more than a hundred creatures with long hair.
S20: They were the Banshees, the forest fairies, all in green.
S22: Banshee: "Good evening, Pooka. Who is this man with you?"
S23: Pooka: "He is the finest piper in all Ireland."
S27: As soon as he played, the air in the cave trembled.
S28: The Banshees began to sway in rhythm.
S31: And they did not stop the whole night.
S37: The piper played without ceasing, and the music was magical.
S39: Until the first rays of dawn touched the cave's mouth.
S40: As a reward, the fairies gave him a full bag of gold coins.
S41: The gold coins gleamed like embers.
S42: Happiest of all, the young man rode home on the Pooka's back.
S43: Piper: "Mother, the fairies rewarded me with gold!"
S44: The neighbors gathered to hear the strange tale.
S46: But when he drew out the bag, the gold coins had vanished.
S48: The young man said nothing. He raised his pipes.
S49: As soon as he played, his song was perfect.
S50: From that day, everyone knew he was the finest piper of all time.
